name: Sasakawa Ai
source: Ai has been friends with the protagonist for a long time. Her feelings towards him are more than just that of a friend. As such, she gets annoyed when he doesn't notice her. Still, she dotes on him, even though she gets teased for being a "wife" to him.
translation: Ai has been friends with the protagonist for a long time. Her feelings towards him are more than just that of a friend. As such, she gets annoyed when he doesn't notice her. Still, she dotes on him, even though she gets teased for being a "wife" to him.
